s.how: Arrange 150g brie, 150g cheddar, 200g crackers, 500g grapes and a handful of dried apricots on a board. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Split a baguette, spread with 80g butter mixed with 3 crushed garlic cloves and parsley. Wrap in foil and bake at 200C for 15 minutes.

m.note: Meredith's Christmas morning strata that ends up on the floor
m.how: Layer 8 slices of torn bread with 150g ham and 150g grated cheese. Pour over 8 eggs whisked with 500ml milk, soak 30 minutes and bake at 180C for 45 minutes. Try not to drop it.

w.note: Christmas morning at the Stone house
w.how: Roll 500g pizza dough flat, spread with 60g butter, 80g brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll up, cut 10 scrolls and bake at 190C for 22 minutes. Ice with 100g cream cheese beaten with 100g icing sugar.

d.how: Brew 1L coffee and serve with warm cream. Make hot chocolate with milk and drinking chocolate for anyone who wants it. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
